subject: Fix remove cached eval scripts on engine unregister (#3503)
reason: The fix only runs inside scriptingEngineManagerUnregister(), reachable solely via VM_UnregisterScriptingEngine() from a scripting-engine module's OnUnload — i.e. MODULE UNLOAD of an engine module (e.g. Lua built as a module). The fuzzer cannot reach it: valkey.action.commands refuses MODULE LOAD/LOADEX/UNLOAD, experiments may not use valkey.action.command, and no installed experiment or fault component loads or unloads a module. With the engine-unregister path untriggerable, no scenario can drive the change.
